definitions.explanation: The player who scores the most points or goals in a league or tournament. A title used primarily in team sports like soccer and basketball.

examples.japanese: {今季|こんき}の{得点王|とくてんおう}は{誰|だれ}だ。
examples.english: Who is this season's top scorer?

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{二年|にねん}{連続|れんぞく}で{得点王|とくてんおう}に{輝|かがや}いた。
examples.english: He won the scoring title for two consecutive years.

examples.japanese: {得点王|とくてんおう}{争|あらそ}いが{最終|さいしゅう}{節|せつ}まで{続|つづ}いている。
examples.english: The race for the scoring title continues until the final match day.

notes:
USAGE:
Used mainly in soccer (Jリーグ), basketball, and other team sports. The suffix {王|おう} (king/champion) is commonly attached to categories to denote the best performer.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {得点王|とくてんおう}に{輝|かがや}く (to win the scoring title)
- {得点王|とくてんおう}{争|あらそ}い (scoring title race)
- {得点王|とくてんおう}を{獲得|かくとく}する (to claim the scoring title)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {新人王|しんじんおう}: rookie of the year — the best newcomer award in a league or sport
